edges.reason: grantPermission authorizes msg.sender against the PermissionGranter permission before writing.
revokePermission authorizes msg.sender against the PermissionGranter permission.
restrict modifier reads permissions[msg.sender][requiredPermission] to gate protected functions.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source of funds.
withdraw restricts the caller to the StabilityBoard permission.
reserve burn restricts the caller to the MonetarySupervisor permission.
issueTo is guarded by restrict modifier keyed on msg.sender.
burn debits the msg.sender balance.
grantPermission writes to the permissions state mapping.
revokePermission writes to the permissions state mapping.
grantMultiplePermissions loops and invokes grantPermission.
revokeMultiplePermissions loops and invokes revokePermission.
restrict modifier gates execution of guarded functions such as issueTo.
transfer delegates value movement to internal _transfer.
delegatedTransfer calls the hash/fee verification helper before transferring.
Signature is passed to ecrecover to derive the signer.
_checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee pays the executor via internal _transfer.
The helper records the tx hash in delegatedTxHashesUsed to prevent replay.
transferFrom delegates to internal _transferFrom.
_transferFrom performs the actual transfer after allowance checks.
_transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] allowance.
_transfer mutates balances using SafeMath add/sub on amount and fee.
feeAccount receives the fee and is used for fee calculation.
transferAndNotify performs an external callback to the receiver after transfer.
delegatedTransferAndNotify calls transferNotification on the target after transferring.
issueTo increases balances with SafeMath add.
issueTo increases totalSupply with SafeMath add.
burn decreases balances with SafeMath sub.
burn decreases totalSupply with SafeMath sub.
approve writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender and spender.
increaseApproval adds to the allowance using SafeMath.
decreaseApproval subtracts from the allowance using SafeMath.
withdraw performs a native ETH transfer to the target when weiAmount > 0.
migrate performs a native ETH transfer to the target when weiAmount > 0.
AugmintReserves.burn invokes AugmintToken.burn on the token contract.
sign requires msg.sender to be an isSigner entry.
execute requires msg.sender to be a signer.
cancelScript requires msg.sender to be the multisig contract itself.
addSigners requires msg.sender to be the multisig contract itself.
removeSigners requires msg.sender to be the multisig contract itself.
sign records the signer in the isSigner mapping via signedBy bookkeeping.
execute delegates to the private _execute function.
_execute performs a delegatecall to the arbitrary script address.
Executed script modifies the scripts mapping state (Done/Failed).
sign calls checkQuorum to determine if the script reaches Approved state.
Main script calls AUGMINT_RESERVES.migrate guarded by the proxy address check.
execute verifies address(this) equals STABILITY_BOARD_PROXY before acting.
execute reads the AUGMINT_RESERVES address to invoke migrate.

normalization_plan.reason: Local computed value only used for balance checks inside the internal transfer.
Parameter is consumed entirely within the internal transfer logic.
Signature count parameter is only used to evaluate the quorum condition.
Script address parameter is used solely to look up and execute the script.
Recovered signer local is only compared against the expected signer.
Script address parameter is only used for the delegatecall and state updates.
